title: A CSV page counts records independently of their labels
summary: A page starting at record two should still return the first input record when its limit is one.

change.description: A page starting at record two should still return the first input record when its limit is one.

notes: The independent JVM oracle covered 24 inputs on each revision. parent mismatches were 10 for count, 10 for labels, 10 for fields. fix mismatches were 0 for count, 0 for labels, 0 for fields.
